requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: The program upgrade authority is a Squads v4 multisig: 3-of-5 voters out of 5 members, with a 10-hour time lock. This is an upper bound: only the program upgrade path is scored, the in-state admin, mint and config authorities are not traced.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-10-10 (first publication of this target). Scored 60 / 69 / 21. The program's upgrade authority is re-read on every run and must equal the offline vault PDA of the named Squads multisig. The time lock was 4 hours when the target was first scored and is 10 hours now (the Watch reported the change).

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData BA7Hr3… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig 51smH7pBDKJDgmVnVks3gMWaPQFfmQ5s4Fc223yHcjuH
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 3-of-5 of 5 plain keys; delay: 10 h Squads time lock
